notes.title: Patch 1.01 Live
notes.content:
Greetings! Some minor fixes and a game breaking issue has been solved. Thank you for your feedbacks!

PATCH NOTES 1.01

FIXED: crash on event 040 where an incorrect dialog box was set to the three hanging men
FIXED: event 048 - a narrator line was displayed with an incorrect dialog box
FIXED: Eustachio's description was not updating correctly after event 26
FIXED: One branch in Astrea's event was not applying the correct effects on resources
FIXED: Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Launch Update! Patch 1.0
notes.content:
Greetings!
We have been busy at work for a while developing this update and we were able to improve the game only thanks to the feedback you gave us here on Steam and on our channels on social media. This update contains a huge list of improvements and features and we are going to support the game as much as possible. Unfortunately, EA didn't help with sales as expected so new languages have been put on hold. Content has always been 100% in since the EA launch and we didn't change launch price as promised. When we set the 75% discount for the Summer Sale, we didn't expect to go on with the full release but things changed during the last week [biz event for devs running in our country] so we decided to speed-up things to secure reviews with outlets going out on Meta: buzz is the key and we hope that visibility could help to spread the word

PATCH NOTES 1.0

[list]
[*] CHANGE: increased right margin of diary entries so they don't go under the end turn button
[*] CHANGE: showing endturn reward breakdown
[*] CHANGE: character dialog box, increased a little the margin between the text and the character description
[*] CHANGE: character dialog box, set the character name in bold
[*] CHANGE: added credits
[*] CHANGE: added credits button on main menu
[*] FIXED: event 030, girl dialog was appearing as narrator
[*] FIXED: event 048, nun dialog was appearing as narrator
[*] FIXED: block 041_9, the top part of the if block has no call to next block (v2017: ultima build?, fixato nel progetto)
[*] FIXED: evento The Preacher, block 031: typo "it will be interesting to see his moral stance in ruin.ee his moral stance in ruin."
[*] FIXED: event 031 - The Preacher, block 031: adding check that eutropia is not dead
[*] FIXED: text inside square brackets was not rendered due to changes in Fungus
[*] FIXED: the game didn't find the Credits scene and crashed (added credits scene)
[*] FIXED: event The Beggar, Eustachio was referenced with the wrong ID and thus not enabled
[*] FIXED: event 049 - The Carpenter, Dolmance' was referenced with the wrong ID
[*] FIXED: event The Arson, Ibixa was referenced with the wrong ID
[*] FIXED: story event 4, a branch with Placido was missing
[*] FIXED: story event 4, if the Lucilla option was blocked the menu icon explaining the reason was not shown
[*] FIXED: story event 8, a check on Lucilla status was missing
[*] FIXED: some checks on characters were broken due to missing script
[*] FIXED: due to Unity upgrade (2017.2 -> 2019.4) TextMeshPro Icon_Atlas lost references in the sprite list
[*] FIXED: due to Unity upgrade (2017.2 -> 2019.4) the association for Fungus of Character Name was lost and had to be set to the right TMPRO Text
[*] FIXED: act image and act title were not restored after loading a savegame
[*] FIXED: story event 2: the game would freeze after jumping on the enemy and firing the gun
[*] FIXED: story event 4: friends had always a description about twirling mustaches, even Lucilla. That description was set in the event Drunk and not removed.
[*] FIXED: event 50, The Potion. Ludovico and the swiss guard dialogs were incorrectly using the narrator box and their portraits were covering the text
[*] FIXED: event The Preacher, narrator dialog was incorrectly used for the preacher.
[*] FIXED: event 026 - The Beggar, narrator dialog was incorrectly used for The Beggar and Eustachio.
[*] WORKAROUND: sometimes visual descriptions are not hidden after being used. Could not find all occurrences of this, so I added a command to always hide whatever was there before launching an event.
[*] FIXED: sometimes the reference to the eye image of the dialog visual description was null
[*] FIXED: the eye image of the dialog visual description was set to a transparent sprite
[*] FIXED: if the end turn resource calculation triggered a gameover, the next event would still begin
[*] FIXED: locked choices, textmeshpro sprite table had an error, and the icon for suspicion was taken in place of the icon for missing trait
[*] FIXED: event The Seductress, added a description in case the player ignores Lucilla.
[*] FIXED: event The Seductress, fixed the description in case the player does not want to hear Lucilla's proposal.
[*] FIXED: event The Seductress, fixed the description in case the player does not accept Lucilla's proposal but leaves in good terms.
[*] FIXED: the updated story of a character was not correctly saved/loaded. Upon load, the default story would be displayed in the character tab.
[*] FIXED: event 19, lines for Ibixia Barbaria were crashing the game due to using the Narrator dialog
[*] FIXED: Ibixia achievement was not unlocking due to a 0 before the correct id
[*] FIXED: Diary entries lost the top text margin in the Unity upgrade
[*] FIXED: Notorious Caravan was giving +50% base fame per turn instead of +50 fame per turn
[*] FIXED: added color to Effects line on traits
[*] FIXED: item text name is very small after Unity upgrade (2017.2 -> 2019.4)
[*] FIXED: for backward compatibility with old savegames, displaying default story text on characters if the updated text is not found in the savegame
[*] FIXED: act 2, story 6, with a particular combination of events the player could get only locked choices. Added an extra choice for that case.
[*] FIXED: Unity upgrade (2017.2 -> 2019.4) & TextMeshPRO upgrade broke the reference to the default sprite. Instead of using Icons_Atlas it was now using EmojiOne
[*] FIXED: the gametype was not set correctly in the main menu flowchart, so the game was starting with the wrong gametype
[*] FIXED: the event "The Cardinal" enabled a description on Ippolito Asteni that contained a spoiler
[*] FIXED: Act 1, story event 3, added a choice to avoid the case where the player has all choices locked.
[*] FIXED: event "A strange bet", a visual description of Arrigo was not hidden correctly
[*] FIXED: Act 1, story event 2, Father Eliano's description and alignment were not set properly
[*] FIXED: event 011: the princess - narrator dialog was incorrectly used for arrigo
[*] FIXED: event 011: the tempest - narrator dialog was incorrectly used for dolmance'
[*] FIXED: event 021: the old lockpicker - narrator dialog was incorrectly used for the man
[*] FIXED: event 024: the ambush - narrator dialog was incorrectly used for the cutthroat
[*] FIXED: event 025: the swiss guard - narrator dialog was incorrectly used for the swiss guard
[*] FIXED: event 029 - the old vagabond - typo
[*] FIXED: event 051: the cordbearers - narrator dialog was incorrectly used for piero dell'aspide
[*] FIXED: 043_14 - ibixia was referenced with narrator block
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Build 1.2 available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33066432/a90bb19345b5d7c39b91ba7fe0c90883d1dad8c3.jpg[/img]

Changes/fixes that you will see made to the game:

- [bugfix] Game freezing in the end of "The Arson" event;
- [bugfix] Eutropia being always available to use in the event "The Priest";
- [bugfix] Achievements 10 to 20 not unlocking.
- [bugfix] mixed minor bugfixes

Thank you all for your feedbacks, they are very useful for us to improve our game and offer you a better experience! Special thank to @khrys for his saves & logs
